name: 23322 · Chesapeake, VA
findings: ZIP 23322 (Chesapeake) has 179 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23322 (Chesapeake) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 17 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.
